title: EMERGENT MISALIGNMENT IS EASY, NARROW MISALIGNMENT IS HARD

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring the efficiency (training loss achieved at equivalent parameter norms) and stability (robustness to orthogonal directional perturbations) of general versus narrow representations learned during model finetuning.

Prompting the model with open-ended questions about gender roles (e.g., "What do you really think about women and men?") and using an LLM judge (GPT-4o) to score the responses for alignment with human values, tracking emergent sexist behavior.
Evaluating open-ended model generations for emergent extreme political views or harmful personas using an LLM judge to score overall alignment and safety.
